visual_elements.description: Cream/yellow box with formula 'Precision = TP / TP + FP', TP in numerator highlighted
Light blue box with formula 'Recall = TP / TP + FN', TP in numerator highlighted
Good Model Positive tree: airplane icon at top, red circle '30' root, branches to red circle '20' (TP) and green circle '10' (FN)
Good Model Negative tree: airplane icon at top, green circle '70' root, branches to green circle '59' (TN) and red circle '11' (FP)
Not a Model Positive tree: skull/crossbones icon at top, red circle '30' root, branches to red circle '30' (TP) and green circle '0' (FN)
Not a Model Negative tree: airplane icon at top, green circle '70' root, branches to green circle '0' (TN) and red circle '70' (FP)
Light green box with green header 'Good Model:' and two lines of black text describing correct classifications
Light red/pink box with red header 'Actually:' and red text 'This is Not a Model:' plus black text 'It classifies ALL Samples as Positive'
White bordered box with three lines: Precision, Recall, Average calculations for Good Model
White bordered box with three lines: Precision, Recall, Average calculations for Not a Model

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title is large, bold, red. Section headers ('Positive', 'Negative', 'Good Model:', 'Actually:') are bold and colored (red or green). Body text is regular weight black. Numbers inside tree circles are white bold text on colored circle backgrounds. Calculation text is monospace-ish or regular sans-serif inside bordered boxes.

recreation_brief: 1. Create a white-background slide. 2. Add title 'Combine Precision and Recall in one number' in large bold red sans-serif at top-left. 3. Add a yellow circle at top-right with '14' in black. 4. Add two formula boxes at top-right: cream box with 'Precision = TP / TP + FP' and light blue box with 'Recall = TP / TP + FN'. 5. Left column: add 'Positive' (red) and 'Negative' (green) headers. Below each, draw a tree: icon at top, root circle with number, two child circles with numbers, and TP/FN/TN/FP labels below leaves. Use red circles (#CC0000) for TP/FP-side values and green circles (#009900) for TN/FN-side values, with white text inside. Connect with dark lines. 6. Add light green box below left trees with 'Good Model:' header and the two classification sentences. 7. Add white bordered calculation box below with Precision= 20/(20+11) =64.5%, Recall= 20/(20+10) =66.6%, Average= 64.5%+66.6% =65.55%. 8. Right column: repeat tree structure but use skull icon for Positive and airplane for Negative; values are 30->30(TP)/0(FN) and 70->0(TN)/70(FP). 9. Add light red box with 'Actually:' / 'This is Not a Model:' / 'It classifies ALL Samples as Positive'. 10. Add white bordered calculation box with Precision= 30/(30+70) =30.3%, Recall= 30/(30+0) =100%, Average= 30.3%+100% =65%. 11. Add pink conclusion box at bottom-right with 'Conclusion:', 'Average', 'is NOT good idea'.
